attributes.name: Rehashed Scans
attributes.description:
Rehashed Scans is not a scanlation group like the others…Well, it's not even a group to begin with. I do everything.

Sometimes I do collabs with friendly groups, mainly typesetting or redrawing for them, but I prefer doing my own stuff alone.
  
[Series I'm currently translating or editing](https://mangadex.org/list/c4aef897-cd25-4a6b-bec3-d81780426bfb/ongoing-works)

Consider manga not on that list to be finished or dropped/not working on it.

I work mainly on yuri manga (as it's one of my favorite genre) but I'm not adverse to other genres. 
  
To note: 

- I'm a working adult  
- I don't do this for money or fame (I don't even have a credit page)
- I mostly suck at redrawing complex SFX so I often leave them as is. Doing SFX is a fool's errand, I tell you.
- I give my best to the translation, but I can't guarantee 100% accuracy. Japanese is sometimes ambiguous and multiple meanings don't translate well.
- I'm alone on this (though I often receive help from other translators for interpretation of ambiguous Japanese sentences).

If you want to contact me, I'm on Dynasty-scans discord.

attributes.name: Giant Ethicist
attributes.description:
It's really just the one guy at this point, and as you can tell looking at my scans I'm a translator rather than an image editor. I hope you can bear with the ugliness and enjoy the comics I share.

My fundamental philosophy could be summed up as "localization is the primary goal" - I'm interested in natural-sounding English that someone with little to no understanding of the Japanese language or Japanese culture can understand clearly much more than slavishly accurate translation, and am willing to lose a little nuance in service of that goal. Untranslated honorifics can get in the bin!*

*In my translations. If you like 'em, you do you.

In principle, I'm open to the idea of getting a proofreader, image editor, and/or whatever on board, but also I'm fundamentally a little lazy and like to work at my own pace... But interested parties can go ahead and drop me a line if you like!

Sometimes I do collabs with friendly groups, mainly typesetting or redrawing for them, but I prefer doing my own stuff alone.
  
[Series I'm currently translating or editing](https://mangadex.org/list/c4aef897-cd25-4a6b-bec3-d81780426bfb/ongoing-works)

Consider manga not on that list to be finished or dropped/not working on it.

I work mainly on yuri manga (as it's one of my favorite genre) but I'm not adverse to other genres. 
  
To note: 

- I'm a working adult  
- I don't do this for money or fame (I don't even have a credit page)
- I mostly suck at redrawing complex SFX so I often leave them as is. Doing SFX is a fool's errand, I tell you.
- I give my best to the translation, but I can't guarantee 100% accuracy. Japanese is sometimes ambiguous and multiple meanings don't translate well.
- I'm alone on this (though I often receive help from other translators for interpretation of ambiguous Japanese sentences).

If you want to contact me, I'm on Dynasty-scans discord.
